notes.title: HandyGames 25th Anniversary + Oddsparks 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
HandyGames turned 25 this year! To celebrate we are offering amazing discounts on some of our all-time fan favorites.

On top of that, we are transitioning our newest game Oddsparks from Early Access to its 1.0 version with loads of new content and improvements - so there is not better time to get it than now!

What are you waiting for? Go to the event and check out our offers!

notes.title: Hotfix for Radeon compatibility issues
notes.notes: Fixed crash at start up happening with the latest Radeon drivers (and perhaps with other configurations as well)

notes.title: Big localization patch
notes.notes:
Added localization for Italian, Korean, Indonesian, Traditional Chinese, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Spanish - Latin America and Arabic (full right to left support!)
Also localized the screenshots in the encyclopedia
Fixed the graphic bug that happened when there are too many buildings with covering range on the map
Various small tweaks and fixes

notes.title: Version 2.2.3 released and miniupdates to 2.2.6
notes.notes:
We released another small patch to address some issues:


Fixed a wrong calculation of the storage space when you have a harbor and completed storage researches
Added trade tab to the harbor menu
Fixed a bug where a construction site could be missing when the assigned Townie was sick
Tweaked some bandit quests so that they should be easier to accomplish
Fixed some quest texts


2.2.4: We also released another small fix which should solve a quest problem in "the Beast" scenario.

2.2.6: Fixed some problems with the Waterways scenario

notes.title: Version 2.2.2 released
notes.notes:
We released a small patch to address open issues:


Tutorial 6 now ends reliable (100% chance that the bandit camp gets discovered)
Harbor can now be reached by all Townies
Went through the quest scripts to hopefully fix all problems with some quests like bandit raids, earn prestige or merchant not coming to town anymore
Fixed a problem with Vsync not saving/working correctly

notes.title: Update 2.1.5 released (more languages!)
notes.notes:
Hi

We are happy to release another update! ːsteamhappyː

We added support for Russian, Portuguese and Simplified Chinese as requested by many players.

Also we analyzed your feedback and:

 Rebalanced general upgrade costs and benefits
 Revised some missions to fix problems and tweak parts that might be too hard
 Reworked sandbox quests to fit better to the current situation and make them easier to achieve in general
 Made some tweaks to the UI and general polishing


We hope you like the changes and are waiting for your feedback in the forums!

Thanks for playing!

Update: No special news for that but we released 2.1.6 which should fix a possible crash when you updated to 2.1.5 while certain buildings were under construction.

notes.title: Patch for pathfinding (2.1.3) released (and 2.1.4 hotfix)
notes.notes:
Hi

Since we got some reports of Townies standing around and doing nothing we tweaked the pathfinding algorithm and testing looks like it should solve the problems.
If you still have issues please report them in the forum!

We are working on more tweaks and features requested by you so stay tuned. :)

Thank you!

Update:
We also just released a hotfix for the crash happening in maps with only 1 season when hovering the mouse over the season icon.

notes.title: Update 2.12 released
notes.notes:
Hi
we released an update that should fix the problem that the game dosn't start on some machines.

That also includes the first hotfix that solved the missing dll problem on Windows 7 systems and the too fast scrolling on high end PCs.

We will keep investigating further problems that you report us.

Thank you!
